text: The port exists, but two links are missing. (1) Harmonize's kit is configured with its Artifact board. The kit repo's own config still points at a local board server, so a part started on the kit repo in the cloud finds no board, and its scripts have nothing to write to. (2) Neither a cloud launch nor kit.py launch writes the part's post: on the web, the kit's launch line only says to start a session. That is what CL13 is for, and it is still planned. I am launching CL13 now with both links added: the kit repo knows it is attached here, and every launch, cloud or CLI, writes its post and Trains row itself. The test is a launch that shows on the board with no hand edits.
